Brain MRI reveals **multifocal, non-enhancing, demyelinating lesions on T1/T2 sequences**, highly characteristic of **Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML)** — a rare, opportunistic demyelinating disease caused by reactivation of the JC virus, typically in the setting of **cell-mediated immune deficiency** (e.g., HIV/AIDS, hematologic malignancies, immunosuppressive therapies such as natalizumab, rituximab, etc.).
